projects.description:
Have done the whole process for getting and showing statistics for a  web application:
-Interchange of messages (Protobuffers and servlets)
-Insertion on data in a database (PotsgresSQL)

-Collection and insertion of the selected data (Quartz Jobs)
-View of the data (Spring MVC)
-Stylized design of the data (Jquery and Protovis)
